data.title: Manage Clients & Teams Across Every Location | Help
data.description: Invite clients, bulk-import your roster with one CSV, add a second coach, and reassign clients across locations — one plan, log and check-in per client.
data.keywords: manage clients TrainZilla, bulk import clients, add a second coach, reassign coach multi-location, client roster, multi-location fitness software

_rationale: Old copy was multi-location-only; surfaced the 'add a second coach' step explicitly (Bulk CSV client import [PARTIAL]) since this is the page a solo trainer hits first when scaling to a team.
